caveats: Scope-(a): measured on the deuteron only. The affine structure licenses reading the magnitude across T / 3He / 4He -- each carries exactly one weighted crossing -- but the linear coefficient is word-specific and is NOT measured for those three. Do not quote 1.41e-4 as their figure.
This does not say which arm is correct. Whether the p-n interface should carry the flavour weighting is a physical modelling choice (bean qou-fv0s); the probe prices it, it does not settle it.

The 1.48e-7 residual between the colour-weighted sum and the committed witness is the q_0 pin straddle decomposed in rho_k_h3a_residual_decomposition.py (8.34e-8 straddle + 1.85e-9 of witness self-inconsistency), not a further disagreement.
